propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 share identical 1M context windows in MODEL_LADDER, making escalation from sonnet to opus a guaranteed-failing paid retry that gains zero additional context.

Context-limit escalation loops (pass1_with_ladder and prerequisites.run_focused_finder) must consume a filtered rung sequence that skips any rung not representing a strict capacity increase over the last kept rung.

New escalation_rungs() function filters models_at_or_above() to exclude non-increasing rungs, while models_at_or_above() and largest_window_tokens() remain unchanged to preserve provider stickiness and size budgets.
Both declared window figures (haiku 200K, sonnet 1M, opus 1M) are verified against live Models API max_input_tokens and are correct; the defect is in ladder consumption, not the table itself.
Structural guards must enforce that MODEL_LADDER windows are non-decreasing and escalation_rungs() returns strictly increasing windows, preventing future no-op escalations.
The silent failure mode is more harmful than wasted spend: operators misdiagnose "even opus failed" when the reality is "escalation never actually happened."
